arStrings.szText: "Some say the blade is the Spear of Light. Are they right?"
(scoffs) Would you repeat the mistakes of Inarius? The Prophecy is not some riddle to be solved, it simply is.
I was there when it was spoken. I was the one who found Rathma. Shivering on the ground. His mouth bleeding – tongue bitten. The words came in great, lurching waves.
He was a terrified boy... looking beyond the curtain of the world for the first time. He did not understand what he saw. Yet somehow his words have become a tool of the desperate and the weak.
Forget the Prophecy. It is of no use to us.
